title: QUAKE II
subtitle: id Software, 1997 · 3.19 with ref_soft, the software renderer — X11
argsHint: `+map <name>` loads a level; `+set vid_ref softx` is the X11 software renderer -- softX, not soft: vid_so.c skips its is-this-owned-by-root check only for a library whose name contains "softx", and the svgalib one it would otherwise want needs root.

needsData.hint: baseq2/ from the shareware or retail release — pak0.pak

_target: The TARGET, not a unit list: the variant comes from the picker beside the program, so a target that grows a second platform layer needs no change here.
_needsData: `dir` is the data ROOT this program's files live under -- a directory served by `serve.mjs --games=<dir>`, named after it. The shell fetches that one when the program starts, and no other: a program's data is not the shelf's data.
